qualifier: via protoporphyrinogen IX to heme A and B
name: Porphyrin and heme biosynthesis
rationale: All members concern synthesis of protoporphyrin and heme (A, B) or heme metabolism, distinguishing the theme from iron-sulfur cluster assembly, tetrapyrrole regulation and erythroid differentiation confusables.

name: De novo purine and pyrimidine nucleotide biosynthesis
rationale: Members cover de novo IMP/AMP/GMP/XMP and pyrimidine/UDP/UTP synthesis, unlike confusables centred on purine salvage, PRPP synthesis, or nucleotide and pyrimidine catabolism.

name: Leptin signalling in appetite and body growth control
rationale: Members combine leptin signalling with regulation of appetite, food response and organism growth, setting the theme apart from ghrelin/feeding-behaviour and growth hormone/prolactin signalling confusables.

core: Mesenchymal stem cell proliferation and differentiation
name: Morphogen-driven mesenchymal stem cell proliferation and differentiation
rationale: Members pair positive regulation of mesenchymal stem cell proliferation and differentiation with BMP/Wnt morphogen signalling, whereas confusables concern committed osteoblast, bone and tendon development.

qualifier: axial midline (notochord, floor plate) and ventral spinal neuron fates
name: Axial midline and ventral spinal cord neuron patterning
rationale: Members span axial mesoderm, notochord and floor plate development with dorsoventral neural tube patterning and spinal motor neuron and interneuron specification, unlike confusables on neural plate border/hindbrain or midbrain dopaminergic neurons.

name: Sleep-wake control and innate social and reproductive behaviour
rationale: Members concern sleep/wake states (including orexin) together with mating, parental, aggressive and drinking behaviours, which distinguish the theme from neuropeptide signalling and feeding-behaviour confusables.

name: Mitochondrial tRNA processing and modification
rationale: All members concern processing, 3'-end maturation and modification of mitochondrial tRNAs, unlike confusables on mitochondrial rRNA/mRNA modification, ribosome assembly or cytosolic tRNA modification and aminoacylation.

qualifier: nucleoprotein maturation and SARS-CoV targeting of PDZ proteins
name: Viral nucleoprotein maturation and SARS-CoV host PDZ targeting
rationale: Members cover maturation of coronavirus and RSV nucleoproteins and SARS-CoV targeting of host PDZ junction and signalling proteins, distinct from confusables on nuclear transport, bacterial entry, or spike/envelope protein maturation.

qualifier: chaperonin folding, HSF1 heat shock and ER/mitochondrial unfolded protein responses
name: Chaperone protein folding and heat shock/unfolded protein responses
rationale: Members span chaperone/CCT-TriC folding, HSF1 heat shock response, ER and mitochondrial UPR and eIF2-kinase translational stress control, distinguishing the theme from stress granule, ER targeting/ERAD, nitrosative stress and FOXO confusables.

name: E3-mediated polyubiquitin chain formation and proteasomal degradation
rationale: Members concern E3 ligase ubiquitination with diverse chain linkages (K6, K11, K27, K29, K48, branched) and promotion of proteasomal degradation, unlike confusables on ERAD/protein quality control, deubiquitinases or degron-rule catabolism.

name: Interleukin signalling centred on Th17 and IL-1 family cytokines
rationale: All members are interleukin signalling or production terms dominated by IL-23/IL-17/Th17 and IL-33/IL-36/IL-38, which separate the theme from type I/III interferon and Dectin/IL-27 confusables.

qualifier: ribosome rescue, mRNA surveillance and degron proteolysis
name: Ribosome quality control, mRNA surveillance and degron-mediated proteolysis
rationale: Members cover translation termination, stalled-ribosome rescue, NMD/no-go decay and N-/C-degron and ribosome-associated protein degradation, unlike confusables on mRNA 3'-end processing, nuclear exosome decay, or translation initiation and elongation factor modification.

qualifier: midbrain dopaminergic and cerebellar granule layer
name: Midbrain dopaminergic and cerebellar granule neuron development
rationale: Members concern midbrain dopaminergic/substantia nigra and cerebellar granule layer and Bergmann glia development with monoaminergic axon guidance, distinguishing them from forebrain, spinal cord and glial fate confusables.

qualifier: internalization, recycling and lysosomal degradation control
name: Regulated receptor internalization, recycling and lysosomal degradation
rationale: Members regulate receptor and cargo internalization, recycling, surface localization and lysosomal targeting, distinguishing the theme from LDL/cholesterol clearance and early-endosome transport confusables.

name: P4-ATPase flippase translocation of aminophospholipids
rationale: Members concern aminophospholipid translocation and its regulation, with both modules centred on P4-ATPase/TMEM30A flippases, unlike ABC transporter, ER-Golgi lipid transfer and scramblase confusables.

qualifier: FasL/TRAIL caspase-8 in T-cell and antitumour responses
name: FasL/TRAIL caspase-8 apoptosis in T-cell and antitumour responses
rationale: Members cover FasL and TRAIL signalling through procaspase-8, c-FLIP and BID with T-cell activation-induced death and tumour defence, distinguishing the theme from necroptosis and thymocyte/allograft confusables.

core: Neural cell fate and differentiation regulation
name: Neuron-glia fate choice and glial differentiation regulation
rationale: Members regulate neuron versus glial (astrocyte, oligodendrocyte, Bergmann glia) fate, differentiation and precursor proliferation, unlike confusables on Schwann cell myelination, forebrain/retinal patterning or forebrain progenitor division.

name: Triglyceride-rich lipoprotein remodelling and receptor-mediated clearance
rationale: Members cover chylomicron/VLDL/LDL remodelling by LPL/LIPC and receptor-mediated internalization and degradation, distinguishing the theme from cholesterol homeostasis/HDL, LDL-cholesterol endocytosis and broader lipid absorption/ABC transporter confusables.

qualifier: epidermal wound healing and epithelial adhesion
name: Keratinocyte proliferation-differentiation balance in epidermal wound repair
rationale: Members regulate keratinocyte proliferation, differentiation and apoptosis together with epidermal wound healing and epithelial adhesion, unlike confusables on hair follicle/melanocyte development, cornification/barrier or keratinocyte migration.

name: Somite segmentation, specification and axis elongation
rationale: All members concern somite formation, rostrocaudal specification and associated axis/tail elongation, distinguishing the theme from limb, Notch glycosylation, neural plate and Hox cluster confusables.

name: Glycerol and acylglycerol metabolism including endocannabinoid lipids
rationale: Members span glycerol/alditol metabolism and transport, mono-, di- and triacylglycerol and phosphatidic acid turnover and endocannabinoid (NAE, DAG-derived) signalling, unlike confusables centred on triglyceride lipolysis or phospholipid synthesis and remodelling.

name: Nucleoside phosphate interconversion and deoxyribonucleotide biosynthesis
rationale: Members concern kinase-mediated interconversion of nucleoside mono-, di- and triphosphates and synthesis of deoxyribonucleotides via pyrimidine salvage, distinguishing the theme from nucleotide catabolism and de novo ribonucleotide synthesis confusables.

name: APC/C inhibitor Emi1 control at metaphase-anaphase transition
rationale: Members concern restraint of APC/C ubiquitin ligase activity and its relief by Emi1 phosphorylation and SCF-beta-TrCP degradation around metaphase/anaphase, whereas confusables cover APC/C:Cdc20/Cdh1 substrate degradation and mitotic exit.

qualifier: MHC expression and T cell antigen presentation
name: Interferon-gamma signalling and MHC antigen presentation regulation
rationale: Members cover type II interferon signalling and its regulation together with MHC class I/II expression, T cell antigen presentation and CD8 T cell proliferation, unlike Th1 differentiation and dendritic cell/IL-12 cytokine confusables.

name: Ribosome quality control and N/C-degron ubiquitin-mediated proteolysis
rationale: Members concern ubiquitin degradation of stalled nascent peptides by RQC and of substrates via N-end and C-end degron rules, distinguishing the theme from stress granule, translation termination/NMD, ERAD and general proteasome regulation confusables.
